integrity: The universal threshold is proved analytically from integer-lattice moment inequalities, explicit moment-matching distributions, and an exchangeable Bernoulli realization. Exact-rational computation only replays formulas over finite parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for three-wise-independent Bernoulli variables with marginal \(1/2\).
The stated sharp threshold is for \(q\ge4\); the small moduli are not part of the claim.
The result minimizes coordinate length rather than the cardinality of a finite supporting sample space.
Targeted originality searches cannot exclude an equivalent formulation in older coding or design literature under different terminology.
title: Sharp length threshold for modular freedom under three-wise-independent fair bits
